info.description: The Marjoram Produce Detail Submission API enables users to add detailed information about marjoram products to the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to enhance their inventory by providing specifications, pricing, and other relevant details. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory specialists looking to keep their catalogs updated and comprehensive. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure accurate and complete information about their marjoram offerings in their product listings.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed entries for marjoram produce. It is designed to facilitate the management of produce details which can include attributes such as quality, quantity, and other relevant information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details regarding marjoram produce. Ensure that all required fields are included and formatted correctly.

200.description: Successfully retrieved details for the marjoram produce.

marjoram_produce_id.description: The unique identifier for the marjoram produce.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the marjoram produce.
